newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Protesters defy Zaire ban, troops surround campus.
newsitem.headline: Protesters defy Zaire ban, troops surround campus.

text.p: Hundreds of Zaireans, defying a ban on anti-Rwanda demonstrations, set up roadblocks in the capital Kinshasa on Tuesday and hijacked cars, witnesses said.
Troops surrounded the university campus in the centre of the city, hotbed of militant students who led protests last week in which homes and property of Tutsis were attacked.
Zaire on Monday banned demonstrations and authorised troops to open fire on anyone caught looting or engaging in vandalism, the government said.
In the last two weeks ethnic Tutsi rebels have seized all the major towns of North and South Kivu provinces in what Zaire terms aggression by the Tutsi-led army of neighbouring Rwanda.
